facts: Parties: Hartwell Medical Ltd (Buyer), Hartwell Engineering Ltd (Seller); the Company is Upton Capital LLP.
This Agreement is dated 26 September 2026; Closing is scheduled for 30 November 2026 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 10.1 (Survival): the General Warranties survive Closing for 18 months; the Fundamental Warranties (title, capacity, tax) survive for 48 months. Claims must be notified in writing before expiry.

Section 9.4 (De Minimis and Basket): the Seller shall not be liable unless the aggregate of all claims exceeds $1,275,000 (0.5% of the Purchase Price), in which case the Seller shall be liable only for the excess over that amount.
Section 9.7: the Buyer must notify any warranty claim within 30 days of becoming aware of it.
Present: 2 directors (of 5). The meeting was quorate. RESOLVED to approve entry into the Share Purchase Agreement.
Article 11: the quorum for board meetings is three directors.
Clause 5.2: a claim against the Escrow Amount must be notified within 45 days of the Buyer becoming aware of it.

Disclosure against Warranty 8.2 (IP): the Company's core platform software was developed in 2023 by an independent contractor, Dunmore Media Ltd. No written assignment of intellectual property was entered into.
